verdicts.reason: Both rewrap the headline well into four balanced lines and keep the colours, serif type and dark pill CTA intact. A's CTA sits closer to the headline, like the original, and reads as one group. B pushes the button down to about 50px from the bottom edge, which leaves a wider gap under the headline and weakens the grouping. Both are a little bottom-heavy, with about 170px of empty orange at the top.
